subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Invention of the Airbag
description: One-minute skill: The Invention of the Airbag.

hook.text: In 1953, a retired engineer named John Hetrick patented an inflatable crash cushion.

buildup.text: His idea sat unused for nearly two decades because no one could inflate a bag fast enough.

discovery.text: By the 1970s, chemical propellants could fill an airbag with gas in just 30 milliseconds.

twist.text: Ford and GM tested early airbags, but abandoned them because some deployed randomly.

climax.text: Mercedes became the first to offer a driver airbag in 1981, proving the concept worked safely.

punchline.text: It took 28 years to make a split-second idea work.

quiz.question: Why were airbags delayed for decades after their invention?
options: Nobody could inflate them fast enough
